summary: With viewContext on (the default), createAiChatHandler sends <view-context and </view-context in the text of user messages to the model as <view-context, so typed or pasted text cannot pose as the view context block. Text without the tag is byte-identical.
howTo: Nothing to do. Only the model input changes, and only for user text that contains such a tag (any case, whitespace or zero-width characters around the /, <view-context-…>; a typed < before the name becomes &lt;). The chat, the stream, the PII shield, the guardrails and a custom streamHandler still get the text as the user wrote it. With viewContext: false (and in the runtime container) nothing changes. Tests that assert the exact model input for a user message containing <view-context need the escaped form.
